notes.title: Sorry for the inconvenience
notes.content:
I accidently changed the name of the executable and steam couldn't find it, there also was some trouble with unity's services but everything has been fixed and tested.

I also apologize for the inactivity I'll try giving more frequent updates as I did before.

What are some things you guys would like to be added to the game?

notes.title: Update, Version 0.99.0
notes.content:
[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed lobby since it caused absurdly annoying syncing problems but now allows the host to change game settings without leaving current game.
[*] Changed some graphics of the game.
[*] Added a setting to give [b]Special Objects[/b] every 4 turns
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Synchronization issues at the start of the game.
[*] Fixed duplication of users in lobby.
[*] Fixed bet system sometimes allowing death players to bet.
[/list]

[b]In Game Lobby:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925810/dc19ff60afe620f8e0f453aa53dac783ed17a2ac.png[/img]

[b]Changing Game Settings[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925810/e54576f9519c2c5729a6c4a592af291348dda793.png[/img]
[list]
[*] To change game settings just press the 'Game Settings' button in the pause menu while in game until it turns green (You have to be host to do this), Once the round finishes you will be able to change the current game settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.98.85
notes.content:
[h1]Added:[/h1]
[h3]Bet System[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925810/335444f8272d8793faa8874db22ccd78df131af4.gif[/img]
Select the [b]position[/b] you want to bet there's a bullet on and how much [b]money[/b] you want to bet, you can bet up to two positions but for a lower reward.
[h3]Player statistics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925810/49081b7e2e9e247b19b1600d5c4d093ddf2840b8.png[/img]
Money is useless for now so feel free to spend it on betting.

[b]Theres more that was added and fixed but I forgot.[/b]

[h2]Next to be added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]More special objects.[/b]
[*] [b]Store.[/b]
[*] [b]Game mode.[/b]
[*] [b]Win condition.[/b]
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Co Op Update!
notes.content:
Play with a friend as a team to win against another opposing team in a [b]2v2[/b] Russian roulette mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925810/8e362a96e8a20fbe6d95ea982821fd89380efee5.gif[/img]

-New "Map"
-Co Op

notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
[b]Fixed[/b]
-Endless loading screen.
-Temporal objects.
-Bot assigning objects.
-Equipable objects not being removed from UI.
-Special object specification.

notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
[b]Fixed[/b]
-Turns may dupe and allow multiple weapons at once.
-Animations may not synchronize.
-Kicking players in lobby.
-Light flickering.

notes.title: Smarter AI
notes.content:
[b]Added:[/b]
-AI now shoots other players.
-AI now uses special objects.
-AI stares at target.

This also works on multiplayer

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
[b]Fixed[/b]
-Player lives displaying incorrectly.
-Kicking players.
-Winning system displaying winner incorrectly.

[b]Added[/b]
-Special objects every 4 turns.
-Game Settings

notes.title: Winning System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925810/27095b70b73a5059aa670af8bbd9dcfde8885721.png[/img]

New winning system! When there's only one player alive, they'll be the winner of the round. Whether you won against your opponents through strategy or pure luck. The round will now reset back to the start with the same game settings and different objects.

More things are to come...
